title: Build 179 — Replies to comments
meta: backend on dev: migration 77, get-comments 2.0.5, post-comment 2.0.7
context: Comments under a post are now **threads, one level deep**.

items: “Reply” with a banner naming who you reply to; “↳ Name” when replying to someone other than the thread's author.
A “Comment deleted” placeholder for a first comment that has replies.

prerequisites: Build **179** or newer, iOS and Android; dev backend.
**Two accounts** (A and B) on two devices.

scenarios.title: Reply to a comment
steps: A writes a comment under a post.
B taps “Reply” under it, writes a reply and sends it.
scenarios.expected: The reply appears under A's comment, indented with a thread line; the banner disappears.

scenarios.title: Android: banner and keyboard
steps: Open the reply field on Android.
scenarios.expected: Neither the banner nor the keyboard covers the field.

scenarios.title: Retry with pull-to-refresh
steps: Pull the list down after a failed send.
scenarios.expected: The failed message is sent again.

deprecated.reason: Changed in build 172: a “Retry” button was added.

scenarios.title: Older backend — flat list
steps: Open comments on stg before the new backend is deployed.
scenarios.expected: A regular flat list without threads; nothing breaks.
